invariant: ADR-0090 D10 rule 5 (amended 2026-10-31, #28367) — the agent forward credential is the ONLY way an agent principal crosses an `api` action's in-process forward, and its four properties are the decision: server-minted (random, naming nothing); bound to one method and one route of one action run; spent by its first presentation, revoked when the forward answers and expired after a fixed bound; and unreachable out of process (it lives in an AsyncLocalStorage slot only the forward's own async chain sees, so a handle presented over the network redeems to nothing). Making it a bearer token, a stored row, a reusable or longer-lived grant, or anything redeemable outside the forward's chain turns it into option C of #28178: a session under another name.
